Pengana Capital Group is again attempting to thwart the Wilson Asset Management-led board's share buyback and increased ownership in the Pengana International Equities LIC (PIA), hoping the Takeovers Panel will intervene.
ASFA welcomes Rest executive to C-suite role
ASFA has named a new C-suite appointment, set to join on September 21 from Rest to strengthen its policy implementation initiative.
WT Financial takes majority stake in TNT Advisor
WT Financial has acquired a 70% stake in paraplanning provider, TNT Advisor Solutions (TNT), for $2.4 million.
State Super announces new board appointment
State Super, the SAS Trustee Corporation, has named a new member of its board, saying the appointment will add to the trustee's governance structure.
